User.title: User Profile
User.description: User profile with avatar, status, and device settings backing up user identity.

id.description: The unique user identifier matching their firebase auth UID.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile change.

Chat.title: Backup Chat
Chat.description: Backup header of a peer-to-peer message thread synced to the cloud.

id.description: Unique chat thread ID, often composed of ownerId and peerId.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this chat backup.

peerId.description: Offline peer device or target identifier.

peerName.description: Name of the offline communication partner.

lastMessageText.description: Text of the most recently sent/received message.

updatedAt.description: Last activity timestamp on the chat thread.

Message.title: Message Backup
Message.description: A single offline peer-to-peer message backed up to the cloud chat thread.

senderId.description: The ID of the peer who sent this message.

text.description: The textual content of the message.

status.description: Message delivery and read receipt status.

attachmentName.description: Optional file name of attached shared file.

attachmentSize.description: Optional file size of attached shared file.

attachmentType.description: Optional MIME type of attached shared file.

FileTransfer.title: File Backup
FileTransfer.description: A record of an offline file transfer backed up to cloud index.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who initiated this backup.

fileSize.description: Size of the file in bytes.

direction.description: Whether the file was transmitted or retrieved locally.

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user profiles stored by authenticated user UIDs.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Individual backup threads of active chat logs.

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Subcollection storing individual message items inside a backup thread.

/files/{fileId}.description: Durable register of shared files and offline document transfers.
